title: Which Ache Is Muscle

mood.label: Heavy going, grief made measurable
mood.summary: Renewed strike threats and an 18-death toll in Iran, a seventh night over Kyiv, Nepal's flooded tunnels, an El Nino warning over Africa's children. Against it: Libya trading rifles for ballots, new vaccine guidance, and a blood test that can name grief.

lines: Eighteen names and two of them children,
a wedding hall that answered to a drone.
Kyiv counts a seventh night of sirens,
Odesa wakes and finds its windows gone.
They drill the flooded tunnel one more metre,
a dry wind leans on Africa's youngest ones.
Thirty-three hundred desks go quiet by the morning —
and in Libya, ballots where they carried guns.
There's a test now that tells grief from a heart attack —
which ache is muscle, and which one is loss.
Somebody sat with the numbers till it was certain.
Heavy going. And somebody still did that.
